description: FREE. One company's SEC filing timeline as we hold it, newest first: form type (S-1, S-1/A, F-1, F-1/A, EFFECT, 424B4, RW, 8-K, ...), filing date, and the link to the document on sec.gov. Use it to follow a registration from first S-1 through amendments to the final prospectus, or to confirm a withdrawal (RW). Covers the filings our SEC syncs collected for the company, not every filing it ever made. Provide exactly one of companyId, symbol, or cik.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros, e.g. 1876042 or 0001876042.

companyId.description: IPOSignal company id (24-character hex), as returned by other IPOSignal responses.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. CRCL. Case-insensitive. Tickers get reassigned, so a response may carry a symbolNote.

name: get_ipo_filings

form.description: SEC form type, e.g. S-1, S-1/A, F-1, EFFECT, 424B4, RW.

filings.description: SEC filings we hold, newest first.

symbolNote.description: Present only when the requested ticker is contested: which registrant it belongs to now vs. the record served.

title: IPO filing timeline (free)
